Frequently asked doorbell camera questions

Do doorbell cameras need WiFi?

Typically, yes. Most doorbell cameras are WiFi-enabled, which allows you to see the camera feed right from your phone as long as your doorbell is connected to your home's WiFi network. With the Vivint Doorbell Camera Pro:

- A notification is sent to your smartphone when a visitor is detected
- You can speak directly to visitors right through your phone

Learn more on choosing a wireless video doorbell camera.

Do doorbell cameras record all the time?

The Vivint Doorbell Camera Pro records video any time the sensors detect a visitor. You can also set Custom Actions to record clips when your windows and doors are opened, doors are locked and unlocked at the keypad, when motion inside is detected, or when an alarm is triggered.

Learn more on how and when doorbell cameras record.

How does the doorbell camera work?

The Vivint Doorbell Camera Pro works using a wireless connection. It integrates a number of features to bring you a safer smarter doorstep, including:

- Live and recorded video
- A microphone and speaker with two-way talk
- Smart visitor and package detection
- Notifications sent right to your phone

Learn more about how a doorbell camera works.

How does a doorbell camera improve my home security?

The Vivint Doorbell Camera Pro is one of the smallest and smartest outdoor cameras in the security market. A smart home system equipped with a doorbell camera allows you to track activity at your front door and stay aware of who comes and goes. The Vivint Doorbell Camera Pro also helps you:

- See who's at the door without opening it.
- Monitor the door remotely when your kids are home alone.
- Capture and watch recordings to keep your doorstep safe.

Explore the security benefits of installing a smart doorbell.

How does a doorbell camera make me more productive?

Today's wireless doorbell is much more than a simple way to alert you to visitors. By showing you who is at your door—whether you're home, away, or don't want to be interrupted—a doorbell camera helps you make decisions about how to interact with the people who stop by. With the Vivint Doorbell Camera Pro you can:

- Speak with visitors remotely with two-way talk
- Give delivery people instructions for leaving packages
- Call for help if you see something suspicious

Learn more about the benefits of a WiFi doorbell camera.

Is a doorbell camera worth it?

Absolutely. It's hard to put a price on the peace of mind and convenience of a doorbell camera— you can answer your door from anywhere, see and talk to whoever's there, and receive notifications on your smartphone alerting you of activity on your doorstep. A doorbell camera is truly an integral component of a home security system.

The Vivint Doorbell Camera Pro takes security and safety even further with its unique ability to detect package thieves and deter them using light and sound. Our doorbell camera doesn't just record packages being stolen. It proactively prevents the crime from ever occurring, which saves our customers money and time.

Learn more about what our customers are saying about the doorbell camera.

What is the best doorbell camera with a monitor?

One of the prime advantages of video doorbells is the capacity for remote monitoring, allowing you to stay connected with your home. This feature should not be confused with our Vivint 24/7 Monitoring team, which provides around-the-clock support in emergencies.

The best video doorbells offer a combination of remote and indoor monitoring, boasting excellent video quality to enhance your home security. These features include:

- A wide-angle field of view, ensuring you can see your entire entryway.
- High-definition video quality that allows for clear identification of visitors.
- Night vision, providing detailed visibility both day and night.
- Video storage for recording and later viewing.

The Vivint Doorbell Camera Pro goes beyond, offering unique benefits. It stands as the only doorbell camera on the market proactively safeguarding your packages from theft. Notifying you upon package arrival, it enables quick retrieval. Additionally, it's equipped with Smart Deter technology, capable of detecting potential lurkers on your doorstep. Once detected, it activates a bright LED ring and a 90 dB speaker, promptly alerting potential intruders that they're under surveillance. See it in and our other products in action.

What are the available add-ons for Vivint HomeProtect?

You can add additional door/window sensors, motion sensors, Doorbell Camera Pro, Chime Extenders, one smart lock, one Vivint Smart Thermostat, and if you purchase a Doorbell Camera Pro you can also add 24/7 recording with Vivint Playback DVR.
